responsibility: This definition module declares the raw C-level getopt interface and the opaque long-option table builder used by GNU Modula-2. It belongs to the command-line parsing interop layer and exposes getopt/getopt_long/getopt_long_only, the global option-result variables optarg/optind/opterr/optopt, and helper procedures to allocate, populate, and retrieve the underlying C long-option array that the higher-level GetOpt module wraps.
